parallels.note: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Aaron shall present the goat on which the lot fell for Yahweh, and offer him for a sin offering.
translations.bsb: he shall present the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering.
translations.kjv: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD'S lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
translations.asv: And Aaron shall present the goat upon which the lot fell for Jehovah, and offer him for a sin-offering.
